findings.F1: In the choppy profile, a coin's one-day return measured in its own 20-day daily swings predicts its excess return over the next 5 days far better than the tested 20-day move. Day-pooled slope 0.1125, t 3.63 on 134 days; with the tails clipped, slope 0.0229, t 2.47. Fitted alongside the 20-day swing-scaled move, the one-day move keeps t 3.21 while the 20-day move drops to t 1.18.
findings.F2: This carry from the one-day move belongs to the choppy profile. Outside it, the same 5-day slope is 0.0079 with t 1.04 on 241 days.
findings.F3: The carry builds with the horizon and is not there the next day or two.
findings.F4: The one-day carry has the same sign on every coin with choppy cases: 9 of 9 coin slopes are positive. The largest t are DOGE 2.16, XRP 1.61 and ADA 1.52.
findings.F5: The one-day carry is uneven and should be read with caution.
findings.F6: Over the next single day, a large swing-scaled one-day move partly reverses in every profile. One-day slope is -0.0045 (t -2.52, 714 days) in the choppy profile and -0.0034 (t -2.52, 1197 days) outside it.
findings.F7: The tested 20-day swing-scaled move is weak and lopsided in the choppy profile.
findings.F8: Despite that, the book's gain came from longs after 20-day rises.
findings.F9: The other angles I looked at stand out from nothing, given how many were examined.

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the larger a coin's one-day return in units of its own 20-day daily swing, the further it moves the same way over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: In a range market, a day that is large against the coin's swings is a reason to trade its direction for about a week rather than fade it.
ideas.name: choppy one-day jump carries

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's one-day return in units of its own 20-day daily swing, the more it moves back the other way over the next day.
ideas.consequence: A trader entering after a large one-day move should expect it to give back part of that move the next day.
ideas.name: next-day giveback after jumps

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the larger a coin's 3-day return in units of its own 20-day daily swing, the further it moves the same way over the next 10 days.
ideas.consequence: In a range market, a few days' move that is large against the coin's swings is a reason to hold its direction for two weeks rather than fade it.
ideas.name: choppy few-day move carries
